about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Who I am and what I do
about.p1: Hi! I’m Liu Qiujing (Tujia), from Tongren, Guizhou, a 2026 graduate in Electronic Information Science and Technology at Guizhou University. From PCB soldering and MCU development to AI toolchain practice, I like turning ideas into working things with my own hands.
about.p2: After graduating in June 2026, I signed an open-ended labor contract with a company and now work on AI document engineering (a DeepSeek-driven three-tier knowledge base). During university I won a national 2nd prize in the Higher Education Cup Advanced Drawing Contest and a provincial 1st prize in the Challenge Cup. I keep going deeper into AI applications / toolchains.
